name: Stale Parrot 18
author: Saiyed-Tanvir
description: Neon 3d green radio button that toggles on and off when clicked.
howItWorks: On hover, transform becomes rotateY(-30deg), transform becomes rotateY(35deg). Clicking it toggles it: text color changes from #00ff6a to #212121, background-color changes to #00ff6a, transform becomes translateX(calc(4.5cm * 0/3)).
